verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a Bills API for creating and managing vendor invoices and an accounts-payable spend product it describes as able to "control, automate, and reconcile" spend. Transfers and batch transfers can pay suppliers, so invoice intake and payment are covered. Nothing in the evidence shows automatic invoice-to-PO matching, GL coding, or approval routing. Missing for 10: purchase-order matching, automatic invoice coding, approval/payment routing workflow, AI-driven automation of the AP flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
